selection_rule: all P0 work families expanded to all unique-coverage PRIMARY_WORK/WORK_PART members; all governed Liuyao/Liuren unique textual coverage included in Wave1
local_helper_role: fetch/pull, run project-owned tests/tools, locate private sources, mechanically expose local page packets; no tracked-file edits, Evidence normalization, commit or push
known_environment_constraints: local helper vision backend returned 401 User not found, therefore SCAN/OCR_WEAK sources require honest VISION_UNAVAILABLE blocking until visual access is restored
sub-agent execution has a 600-second hard limit and is not an accepted whole-domain or whole-book reading architecture
previous parallel dispatch attempts are not reading evidence; only provenance-valid local output may be reused after project-side review
rules: Evidence Extraction records only what a source explicitly supports; no claim synthesis or conflict resolution in K2B
reading coverage is tracked separately from evidence count
if any member of a selected work family is P0, all PRIMARY_WORK/WORK_PART unique coverage for that work_id enters the wave
SAME_WORK_VARIANT is a backup carrier and never an independent vote
SECONDARY_NOTE, IMPLEMENTATION and AUXILIARY_INDEX do not enter traditional textual Evidence Extraction
TEXT_OK sources use TEXT_DIRECT and may be reviewed from mechanically extracted page-preserving text layers
SCAN/OCR_WEAK/OCR_FAIL sources use VISUAL_REQUIRED and cannot become COMPLETE without original-page visual verification
semantic-UNKNOWN textual sources remain in a discovery backlog and must be content-reviewed before K2B can be globally complete
modern long-form text, scans and local page packets remain private; public records contain only derived facts, locators and short metadata
